title: My Favourite Clothes
description: Practise have got, possessives and like + -ing, and describe your favourite clothes.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "have got" with I, you, we and they: I have got.

exercises.prompt: Write the word in brackets with 's.
answers: brother's
exercises.explanation: Add 's to a person to show that something belongs to them: my brother's T-shirt.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I like wearing jeans.
exercises.explanation: Subject + like + -ing form + noun: I like wearing jeans.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My shoes is black and white.
answers: My shoes are black and white.
exercises.explanation: Shoes is plural, so use "are": my shoes are.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: With he, she or it, make the negative with doesn't + base verb: she doesn't like.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with and, but or because.
exercises.text: I love my hoodie ___ it is warm and soft.
answers: because
exercises.explanation: "Because" gives the reason: I love it because it is warm.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct answer.
exercises.text: These ___ are too small for me.
exercises.explanation: Use "these" with plural nouns: these shoes.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: I have got a orange scarf.
answers: I have got an orange scarf.
exercises.explanation: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an orange scarf.

exercises.prompt: Complete with is or are.
exercises.text: There ___ two pockets on my jacket.
answers: are
exercises.explanation: Use "there are" with plural nouns: there are two pockets.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My favourite colour is blue.
Blue is my favourite colour.
Is my favourite colour blue?
exercises.explanation: Subject + is + noun/adjective: My favourite colour is blue.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "her" before a noun to show that something belongs to a girl or woman: her dress.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My dad wear a suit to work.
answers: My dad wears a suit to work.
exercises.explanation: With he, she and it, add -s to the verb: my dad wears.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" with seasons: in winter, in summer.

exercises.prompt: Complete the question.
exercises.text: ___ I wear your hat? Yes, you can.
answers: Can
exercises.explanation: Use "Can I ...?" to ask for permission.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: There is a cat on my T-shirt.
On my T-shirt there is a cat.
Is there a cat on my T-shirt?
exercises.explanation: There is + a singular noun + place: There is a cat on my T-shirt.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: My brother have got a new cap.
answers: My brother has got a new cap.
My brother's got a new cap.
My brother has a new cap.
exercises.explanation: Use "has got" with he, she and it: my brother has got.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: My jeans are old, ___ I love them.
exercises.explanation: Use "but" to join two different or opposite ideas.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: Is this your sweater?
exercises.explanation: Use "Is this ...?" with one thing and "Are these ...?" with more than one.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I don't wear my uniform on Sundays.
On Sundays I don't wear my uniform.
exercises.explanation: Subject + don't + verb: I don't wear my uniform.

exercises.prompt: Complete the question with do or does.
answers: do
exercises.explanation: Use "do" in questions with I, you, we and they: What do you wear?

contentPoints: Say what your favourite clothes are.
Describe their colour and how they feel.
task.modelAnswer: My favourite clothes are my blue jeans and my green hoodie. The hoodie is big, warm and soft. I wear them at the weekend and when I go to the park. I like them because they are comfortable and I can play in them.
